links.outcome: Comprehension of AI-generated plain-language consent forms versus standard forms
links.effect: Comprehension 82.9% with ChatGPT forms vs 77.3% with standard forms (p = 0.04); forms had shorter sentences and lower linguistic complexity (Flesch 39.2; Ateşman 53.9).
links.quote: Participants who read ChatGPT-generated consent forms achieved higher comprehension scores than those who read standard forms (82.9 % vs. 77.3 %, p = 0.04).

unlisted_practices: Using generative AI to rewrite informed consent forms for improved patient comprehension

screen.reason: Prospective randomized trial evaluating patient comprehension and readability of ChatGPT-4o-generated informed consent forms compared to standard forms.
